caption:
₹50,000 a month today: what will the same life cost you in 20 years?

At an illustrative 6% inflation, ₹50,000 a month becomes ≈ ₹1.6 lakh a month in 20 years.
That's ≈ ₹19.2 lakh a year, so ₹1 crore would cover only about 5 years of it, before any returns.
Illustrative only: your own costs, inflation and returns will differ, and returns are not guaranteed.
Plan your retirement number in future prices, not today's.

What monthly spend are you planning for when you retire?
Send this to the friend who says ₹1 crore is enough.

Sources: a financial planner's retirement guides using 6% yearly inflation (₹1 lakh a month today ≈ ₹3.21 lakh in 20 years; ₹50,000 ≈ ₹89,542 in 10 years); ₹50,000 × 1.06^20 ≈ ₹1,60,357 calculated.

For education only. Not investment advice.
